props.implementation_note: Choose one option when you use it; it applies to EVERY creature in the conflict (you, allies and enemies) until the start of your next turn. Costs: each creature's actions with a printed MP cost cost double (the extra is added to the action card). Not doubled: MP a skill spends inside its own effect chain (e.g. Gadgets, Stolen Time, High Speed). A creature that cannot afford the doubled cost is not stopped automatically: it spends all its remaining MP and the action still resolves, so the GM should rule that action out at the table. Damage: every hit any creature takes gets +SL×3 before Affinities; typeless/true damage is not increased.
props.name: Bishop's Edict

effects.description: Double Arrow: attack twice with a lone bow (two-weapon fighting; HR as 0).
effects.name: Double Arrow

props.description:
When you perform the Attack action with a ranged weapon that belongs to the bow Category, if you have no other weapon equipped, you may perform two separate attacks instead of one (against the same target or against different targets).

If you do, both attacks follow the rules for two-weapon fighting: each attack loses the multi property and cannot gain it, and you treat the High Roll (HR) of each Accuracy Check as 0 when determining damage dealt by it.

This Heroic Skill does not stack with a custom weapon's quick customization.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered one or more Classes among Commander and Sharpshooter.

props.description:
After you hit one or more creatures with a melee attack using a weapon that belongs to the spear Category, if you have no other weapon equipped, you may spend 20 Mind Points and choose one of those creatures. If you do, the attack deals half the normal amount of damage to each of its targets, and you choose one type of action from the following:

  • 【⚔️Attack】

  • 【🛡️Guard】

  • 【❗️Objective】

  • 【📕Spell】

  • 【💥Skill】

From now on, the chosen creature must spend 10 Mind Points whenever they wish to perform that type of action. If they can’t, they must perform a different type of action. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn, or until you use this Skill again.
